_note: The IPM ladder. Rung 1 costs nothing, rung 2 costs a little, rung 3 is chemistry. The engine will not offer rung 3 until the economic threshold is crossed, so this is the part of the app that is always available and the part a farmer can act on when money is the constraint — which the NPSS compliance study says is the actual reason advice goes unfollowed.
